set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KWYS7H6C4XP4GGERQXXMH98S. Create the scalafim-connectivity crossProject as a shared-first module depending only on linalg and multivar. Update build.sbt aggregates/aliases, README/module blurbs, and docs/module-relations.md so the boundary is explicit: no dataset, atlas, BIDS, plotting, JVM IO, TVGL/SRLC/phase/HMM internals in the structural core. Acceptance: connectivityJVM/compile and connectivityJS/compile exist, module docs name the boundary, and no new dependency cycle is introduced.
set.title: Connectivity module skeleton and boundary docs
